title: This workflow allows you to change characters with both front and back consistency in any video 🔥
description: Comment “AI” to try it yourself!Flow Studio by Autodesk lets you replace characters in your scenes with a 3D model, keeping your character consistent from front to back across every shot. It automatically applies the correct lighting from the scene onto your character, giving you full creative control without complex VFX setups. A game-changing tool for filmmakers, creators, and anyone building narrative AI content.#FlowStudio #Autodesk #AICharacterDesign #AIVFX #CreativeAI1w
